       !(RttWalk_(old_s, CurrentRealm(old_s), base,RMM_RTT_PAGE_LEVEL as int,RMM_RTT_TREE_PRIMARY as int).rtte.state != ASSIGNED_VSMMU))
    ==> result == RSI_SUCCESS)
}
